name: Marlowe Fairwind
description: The personal mage to King Emeris, responsible for bringing the group together.
story: Marlowe appears calm until she isn’t; she is the one who brings the adventuring party together on the mission to Hush.
question: Why do you think King Emeris trusts you more than anyone else to deliver this package?

settings.class_feature: Volatile Magic: Spend 3 Hope to reroll any number of your damage dice on an attack that deals magic damage.

name: Barnacle
description: A fearless Underborne ribbet rogue who gets into trouble without hesitation.
story: Barnacle is always ready to leap into danger and will not go near water.
question: What strange or interesting rumor have you heard about the Sablewood?

settings.class_feature: Rogue’s Dodge: Spend 3 Hope to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you.

name: Garrick Reed
description: A defector from a distant military force who solves most conflict with a kind attitude and a blade.
story: Garrick is a straightforward ally who prefers to win by steel and calm confidence.
question: What has Marlowe asked of you previously that made this mission difficult to say yes to?

settings.class_feature: Combat Training: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

name: Khari Nix
description: A loyal Ridgeborne giant guardian who would defend her allies to the end.
story: Khari has a dry sense of humor and a strong instinct to protect everyone around her.
question: Your community called the Sablewood something else. What was their name for it, and why?

settings.class_feature: Unstoppable: Once per long rest, you can become Unstoppable and gain a temporary damage bonus while reducing incoming physical damage severity.

name: Varian Soto
description: A Wildborne katari ranger who prefers to solve problems with a bow and a quick draw.
story: Varian takes a shoot-first, ask-questions-later approach while exploring the Sablewood.
question: What hybrid animal have you been hunting for years that you’re hoping to see while in the Sablewood?

settings.class_feature: Ranger’s Focus: Spend a Hope and make an attack against a target; on success, they become your Focus and you gain tactical benefits against them.
